description: Seed concept-to-curriculum map. Detailed progression remains in the referenced research/progression files so this map does not duplicate or overwrite evidence.

system_notes.CN: Use the 2022 national mathematics standard for national requirements. Exact current PEP grade/semester placement is added only from verified 12th-series evidence.
system_notes.UK: UK key is retained for compatibility, but statutory curriculum claims refer to England.
system_notes.US: Use Common Core as the baseline comparison framework and identify it as such; state-specific mappings can be layered separately.

CN|UK|US.placement_summary: Short summary only; detailed placement is resolved from research_file_refs.
research_file_refs: Files containing the detailed evidence and source locators
CN|UK|US.publication_rule: Any evidence limitation that must be preserved in teacher-facing output.

CN.placement_summary: National progression is verified at Grades 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6 learning-stage level. Grade 1 upper has partial current-PEP evidence; full single-grade sequence remains incomplete.
CN.publication_rule: Do not convert a learning-stage requirement into an exact Chinese grade unless current 12th-series textbook evidence supports it.

UK.placement_summary: Year-by-year place-value progression is verified for Years 1-6 in the National Curriculum in England.
UK.publication_rule: Label statutory claims as England, not the whole UK.

US.placement_summary: Common Core grade-by-grade place-value/base-ten progression is verified for Grades 1-6, with Grade 6 moving into the broader rational-number system.
US.publication_rule: Present Common Core as the US baseline, not as a universal US curriculum.

CN.placement_summary: Current national and PEP evidence supports connected development of multiplication meaning and related operations, but exact current Grade 1-6 PEP sequencing is not yet fully verified.
CN.publication_rule: Do not publish a precise current Chinese grade introduction point unless the relevant 12th-series volume is verified.

UK.placement_summary: England develops grouping, sharing and arrays in Year 1, formal multiplication/division structures and 2/5/10 facts in Year 2, then extends facts and written methods through later years.
UK.publication_rule: Separate statutory expectations from non-statutory teaching guidance.

US.placement_summary: Common Core uses equal groups and arrays in Grade 2 as foundations and formally defines products and quotients in Grade 3 before later multi-digit methods.
US.publication_rule: Common Core standards specify mathematical expectations and representations but do not prescribe one complete teaching method.

CN.placement_summary: Fraction development is verified at national learning-stage level and linked to the current PEP counting-unit structure; exact current semester sequence remains pending.
CN.publication_rule: Use learning-stage wording unless a current textbook volume verifies the exact grade/semester.

UK.placement_summary: England introduces halves and quarters in Year 1 and develops fraction meaning, equivalence, number-line interpretation and operations progressively through Year 6.
UK.publication_rule: Keep statutory requirements separate from recommended representations in guidance.

US.placement_summary: Common Core uses equal-share foundations in Grades 1-2 geometry and begins the formal fractions-as-numbers domain in Grade 3.
US.publication_rule: Use Common Core for curriculum placement and the IES guide only for pedagogical/research rationale.

CN.placement_summary: National-stage fraction evidence supports fraction relationships and operations, but exact current PEP placement of formal equivalence work remains pending direct volume verification.
CN.publication_rule: Do not infer current PEP unit placement from a legacy textbook sequence.

UK.placement_summary: England develops simple equivalence from Year 2, equivalent-fraction families in Year 4, and uses equivalence increasingly in comparison and calculation through Years 5-6.
UK.publication_rule: Representations are teaching guidance unless explicitly stated in the statutory programme of study.

US.placement_summary: Common Core begins formal fraction equivalence in Grade 3 and develops explanation/generation of equivalent fractions with visual models in Grade 4.
US.publication_rule: Use IES to explain evidence-based instruction, not to establish the grade placement.

CN.placement_summary: The 2022 national standard places area in the Grades 3-4 learning stage, including area as an attribute, square units, estimation/measurement and distinction from perimeter. Exact current PEP grade/semester remains pending.
CN.publication_rule: State the verified Grades 3-4 learning stage unless current textbook evidence narrows the placement.

UK.placement_summary: England explicitly develops area from counting squares in Year 4 to calculating/comparing rectangle area and estimating irregular area in Year 5, with formula work extended in Year 6.
UK.publication_rule: Use the statutory year placement for curriculum claims and separate any teaching representation advice.

US.placement_summary: Common Core Grade 3 defines area as a measurable attribute in square units and explicitly connects rectangle area to multiplication and addition.
US.publication_rule: Present Common Core as the baseline and keep state-specific differences separate.
